import re, unicodedata
SP = r"C:\wt\logos-t423-m8-fable\.ai\scratch\multi_model_bible_chunking\M8_fable\sp_durable"
O = dict(l.split("\t", 1) for l in open(SP + r"\Dan\Dan_oshb.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n") if "\t" in l)
W = {}; ch = None; cur = None
for l in open(SP + r"\Dan\Dan_web_clean.txt", encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n"):
    m = re.match(r"===== DAN (\d+) =====", l)
    if m: ch = m.group(1); cur = None; continue
    m = re.match(r"\[v\] (\d+) (.*)", l)
    if m: cur = "%s:%s" % (ch, m.group(1)); W[cur] = m.group(2); continue
    if cur and l.strip() and l.strip() != "\u00b6": W[cur] += " " + l.strip()
def sk(s):
    return "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s) if not (0x0591 <= ord(c) <= 0x05C7))
ROOTS = "\u05d0\u05de\u05e8|\u05e2\u05e0\u05d4|\u05de\u05dc\u05db"
for ctl in ("Dan.7.22", "Dan.7.23", "Dan.7.27"):
    hits = [(i + 1, sk(w)) for i, w in enumerate(O[ctl].split(" ")) if re.search(ROOTS, sk(w))]
    print("control, OSHB/WLC", ctl, "tokens holding a skeleton of", ROOTS, ":", len(hits), hits)
n = 0
for r in ("Dan.7.25", "Dan.7.26"):
    hits = [(i + 1, sk(w)) for i, w in enumerate(O[r].split(" ")) if re.search(ROOTS, sk(w))]
    n += len(hits)
    print("OSHB/WLC", r, "tokens holding a skeleton of", ROOTS, ":", len(hits), hits)
print("OSHB/WLC total in Dan.7.25-Dan.7.26:", n)
print("OSHB/WLC Dan.7.26 word 1 skeleton:", sk(O["Dan.7.26"].split(" ")[0]), "| first letter is waw:", sk(O["Dan.7.26"].split(" ")[0])[0] == "\u05d5")
PAT = r"\b(said|says|say|answered|answer|replied|kingdom|kingdoms)\b"
for ctl in ("7:22", "7:23", "7:27"):
    print("control, WEB", ctl, [h.group(0) for h in re.finditer(PAT, W[ctl])])
m = 0
for r in ("7:25", "7:26"):
    hits = [h.group(0) for h in re.finditer(PAT, W[r])]
    m += len(hits)
    print("WEB", r, "words matching", PAT, ":", len(hits), hits)
print("WEB total in 7:25-7:26:", m)
